message.content: /seldon Toolshed is our community tool library. we lend drills, ladders, saws, all of it, out of a paper logbook, and stuff walks off because nobody knows who has what or when it's due. I want something the volunteers can use at the counter to check tools out and back in, plus a catalog members can look at from home. it's for the volunteers on the counter and our few hundred members, and starting this fall the woodshop class at Alder Street School borrows from us too, their teacher picks up for the whole class. checking a tool out has to take under a minute or the line backs up. Scope is the catalog, checkouts, returns, and a reminder when something's due. It's free for members, and none of us has time to deal with money. no reservations. whoever's standing at the counter gets the tool, first come first served. a volunteer looks over every tool going out and coming back, so no self checkout. Stakes are low: it's a volunteer library, and a wrong call costs us an afternoon of fixing.
